translations.web: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
translations.bsb: But if the spot remains unchanged and does not spread, it is only the scar from the boil, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
translations.kjv: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
translations.asv: But if the bright spot stay in its place, and be not spread, it is the scar of the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
